item.title: Bryan Norcross: Developing low pressure in the Atlantic still has a chance to be named Kyle

item.title: Alaska Science Forum Time Capsule: Bats in the belfry
item.description: Note: Ned Rozell wrote this column on Oct. 25, 1994, his first as the new author of the Alaska Science Forum. I’m pleased to feature this time capsule, as it explores one of my favorite questions in biology: How do mammals survive in intensely cold temperatures? Additionally, Ned ended the story with, in my opinion, a perfectly silly final sentence. Ned published an update on Alaska’s little brown bats in 2019: https://bit.ly/bat-update . — Sara Wilbur
